answer:
I renamed the Amt column to "Amount (kr)" in Household expenses.

The page found that column by its old name, so the rename would have broken the total and the amounts. I changed the page to look for "Amt" or "Amount" at the start of the name. I haven't opened it in the app to check it, so it's worth a quick look. The previous version of the page is kept if you want to go back to it.
